chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'One dirham of usury is greater in the sight of Allah than twenty acts of adultery, all with a close relative.'
ai.seo_question: How does the severity of usury compare to adultery in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) states that a single dirham of usury (riba) is considered greater in the sight of Allah than twenty acts of adultery (zina), specifically those committed with a close relative (dhawat mahram). This highlights the high status and severity of usury in Islamic jurisprudence, emphasizing its unique weight in divine judgment compared to other major sins.
